name: Picnic Syndrome
source:
Nutopia is now booting...

[spoiler]Hello, Hello? Is someone there?[/spoiler]

Teddy is an artificial intelligence commissioned to start testing the virtual world "Nutopia" while also testing another new artificial intelligence, Vincent the wolf pup.

However, as Teddy's testing progresses, it seems to be more than just testing.
[I]It has became a game.[/i]

[spoiler]I have no choice but to upload it somewhere, can somebody see it?[/spoiler]

[I]Following in the footsteps of Teddy, let's explore Nutopia's secrets, dive into the story of its owner, and hang out with Vincent along the way![/i]

[spoiler]He's going too far this time, I really need you help, please![/spoiler]

[From [url=https://asepticdog.itch.io/picnicsyndrome]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Nutopia正在启动…

[spoiler]你好，你好？有人在吗[/spoiler]泰迪是一个人工智能，受委托开始测试虚拟世界“Nutopia”，同时也测试另一个新的人工智能——狼崽文森特。

然而，随着泰迪测试的进展，它似乎不仅仅是测试那么简单。
[I]它已经成为一个游戏。[/i]

[spoiler]我没办法，只能上传到某个地方，有人能看到吗？[/spoiler]

[I]跟随泰迪的脚步，探索Nutopia的秘密，深入了解它主人的故事，并与Vincent一路闲逛！[/i]

[spoiler]他这次太过分了，我真的需要你的帮助！[/spoiler]

[来自[url=https://asepticdog.itch.io/picnicsyndrome]Itch.io[/url]]
